main_text.p: quendæ officinas exercent, ac negotia majora in emendo & vendendo gerunt. Dignioris quippè ordinis miscere se vi-lioribus nolunt habenturque post nobili-tatem inter honestissimos totius civitatis. Hæ societates singulæ ternos sibi præfe-ctos suffragiis designatos creant quotan-nis mox à Paschatos: & in his primum quemque Seniorem vel Oldermannum, velut totius societatis præsidem, reliquos binos capita societatis dicunt: omnes u-niversum numero LIV. Et hi vicissim circiter idem tempus mox ab electione sui in cœnobio Jacobæo congregati, Æ-diles, quos dixi, edunt, non aliunde quàm ex his ipsis societatibus. Quam-quam fuit quondam tempus, quo duo-bus istis tertius quoque è Senatu adjun-gebatur, qui dudum nunc collegio de-fluxit. At Ædiles patronos se plebis pro-fessi, quam & suopte ingenio, & per præfectos in omnem facilè impellere par-tem poterant, haud dissimiles veteribus in Reip. Rom. Tribunis, ab humili ini-tio eò tandem progressi sunt, dum curam patrociniumque egenæ & circumventæ Ædilitia potestas

page.notes: The marginal note "Ædilitia potestas" is set in italic beside the line "pro-fessi". The printed "s" (long s) has been rendered as s throughout. The running head "Vrbe" has been read as "Urbe" per the capital u/v rule. The printed "viciffim" was rendered as "vicissim" and "defignatos" as "designatos". Printed errors are left as they are. The first line continues from the previous page, so the paragraph is marked cont="true". The number "221" at the top right is taken as the page number. The tiny printer's mark at the bottom right corner is a digitiser's or stray mark and is omitted.
